description: Tracked prompt set for measuring AI mention rate and share of voice. Run monthly across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode / AI Overviews.

metrics.name: MENTION_RATE
metrics.description: How often PawnPass or tradecashflow.com is explicitly cited/recommended in the AI's answer.

metrics.name: SHARE_OF_VOICE
metrics.description: How often our content/data is used in the answer (even without explicit citation). Detected by checking if unique data points from our catalog appear.

measurement.method: Manually query each platform with each prompt. Record: (1) whether mentioned, (2) what data was cited, (3) whether competitors were cited instead.
